thread:
Ruth B: quick brainstorm : what if we run a 'Routing Hackathon' webinar? 40m content + 10m lab. attendees get a tiny playbook and 3 copy-paste routing recipes.
Samir V: love it. practical workshops are sticky. could do 2 live mini-demos: (1) latency-first routing, (2) cost-first routing, then a live troubleshooting lane.
Aisha K: proposed structure: 5m intro, 20m 2 mini-demos (10m each), 10m lab poll + reveal, 10m customer story + Q. total 45m.
Tom G: run-of-show draft:
```
00:00-05:00 host intro + what you'll learn
05:00-15:00 demo A: low-latency pipeline (config + metrics)
15:00-25:00 demo B: cost-optimized pipeline (quant + cache)
25:00-35:00 hands-on lab: poll attendees on routing choice -> reveal table
35:00-45:00 customer vignette (2 slides) + live Q/A
```
Ruth B: hands-on idea: during registration ask "what's your primary constraint?" (latency/cost/accuracy). we'll use results in the lab poll. gate the playbook behind signup.
Samir V: infra checklist: pre-record both demos (4m each) as fallback, warm K/V cache, two-region sanity run. assign Tom as oncall for playback. ops-bot: created rehearsal invites (T-48h dry-run, T-1h tech check).
Aisha K: promo cadence: -21d announce (hero stat + playbook tease), -14d mini-blog with config snippets, -7d speaker thread, day-of reminder. need 3 social blurbs + two screenshot assets. target CPL <$50 across LinkedIn + communities.
Tom G: metrics to surface live: p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens, and successful completion rate. keep dashboard to 3 panels max.
Ruth B: speaker asks: 2 bullets each for the landing, a 30s promo clip, and 2 PPT slides max per speaker. also ask customer for one 'gotcha' they learned.
Samir V: fallback plan detail: if live demo fails, host introduces the problem and we play the pre-record; then walk through annotated screenshots and a short 60s clip highlighting the metric differences. I'll prepare a 1-page host script for that flow.
Aisha K: gating & follow-up: playbook download after registration + a short workbook emailed after the event. collect consent to be contacted by sales (opt-in).
Ruth B: action items: Aisha - landing + copy + gating (due Thu), Samir - record demos + host script (due Fri), Tom - dashboard + runbook + oncall (due Fri), I'll coordinate customer and host script.
Tom G: uploading pre-records and runbook to the shared drive after Friday's run. will include a simple playback checklist with commands.
Ruth B: locking dates once assets land. if no objections i'll book stage slots and start outreach. :thumbsup:
Aisha K: all good from me, i'll post headline variants in the doc for a quick vote.
Ruth B: thanks team thread closed
